description: This Java class 'SimpleMapProcessor' provides methods to load, cache, and execute mini-language map processors defined in XML files within the OFBiz framework. It handles XML parsing, caching of processor configurations, and running processors with specified input and output maps.

classes.name: SimpleMapProcessor
classes.description: Main class providing static methods to load, cache, and execute mini-language map processors from XML resources or URLs.

methods.name: getAllProcessors
methods.description: Loads all MapProcessor instances from a given XML URL, parsing the XML document and extracting 'simple-map-processor' elements.

methods.name: getProcessors
methods.description: Retrieves MapProcessors for a given XML resource and processor name, loading and caching them if necessary.

methods.name: getProcessors
methods.description: Retrieves MapProcessors for a given XML URL and processor name, loading and caching if necessary.

methods.name: runSimpleMapProcessor
methods.description: Executes a named MapProcessor from an XML resource with provided input and output maps, messages, and locale.

methods.name: runSimpleMapProcessor
methods.description: Executes a named MapProcessor from an XML URL with provided input and output maps, messages, and locale.
